===Etymology 1===

# to [[press]], to [[squeeze]]
#: {{uxi|ru|'''жать''' [[рука|ру́ку]]|t=shake hands}}

# to [[pinch]], to hurt, to be tight
#: {{uxi|ru|[[о́бувь]] '''жмёт'''|t=the shoes are tight (''too small'')|lit=the shoes '''squeeze'''}}
